title: Buchanan bilocates to Cydonia on Mars, later matched to a photo at Puthoff's

tellings.quote: And uh the first time that happened to me was with the Sedona region at Mars.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says the first time he felt himself in two places at once, he was in the Cydonia region of Mars (he calls it "the Sedona region at Mars"). He tells it as something that happened to him, and he says what he saw there was later matched to a photograph at the home of a man named Hal Puthoff, which would mean his mind had really reached Mars.
